title: Scientists Use ‘Grand Theft Auto’ to Model the Effects of Climate Change

claims.claim: Grand Theft Auto serisi dünya genelinde tahmini 465 milyon adet sattı.

evidence.quote: As of this year, the franchise has sold an estimated 465 million units worldwide

claims.claim: Serinin son oyunu GTA VI, ilk gün satışlarında 3,79 milyar dolar kazandı.

evidence.quote: the latest installment in the series, GTA VI, earned $3.79 billion in first-day sales.
made $3.79 billion on release day to mark what could be the biggest entertainment event ever
GTA VI launched as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic and made $3.79 billion on release day

claims.claim: Araştırma, Almanya'daki Potsdam Üniversitesi'nden Paul Nörenberg ve Alfred Wegener Enstitüsü'nden Hugues Lantuit tarafından yürütüldü.

evidence.quote: These specs were leveraged by Paul Nörenberg, a professor at the University of Potsdam in Germany, and his colleague Hugues Lantuit of the Alfred Wegener Institute, who conducted an experiment
These specs were leveraged by Paul Nörenberg, a professor at the University of Potsdam in Germany, and his colleague Hugues Lantuit of the Alfred Wegener Institute, who conducted an experiment...
The authors of the study, published in Geoscience Communication, created a digital model based on the video game’s three-dimensional terrain maps.

claims.claim: Araştırmacılar, Birleşmiş Milletler Hükümetlerarası İklim Değişikliği Paneli'nin (IPCC) RCP 2.6 ve RCP 8.5 olmak üzere iki iklim senaryosunu kullandı.

evidence.quote: The researchers calculated these possibilities based on two climate scenarios used in the projections of the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC). The first, known as RCP 2.6, assumes that countries implement effective measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and limit global warming. The second, called RCP 8.5, envisions a scenario of high emissions without sufficient mitigation measures.

claims.claim: Model, yüksek emisyon senaryosunda ve fırtına dalgası durumunda 2300 yılına kadar deniz seviyesinin yükselmesinin ve kıyı taşkınlarının 5,18 metreye ulaşabileceğini gösterdi.

evidence.quote: The results showed that, in a high-emissions scenario and in the event of a storm surge, sea-level rise and coastal flooding could reach 5.18 meters by 2300.

claims.claim: 2500 yılı için yapılan tahminler, birleşik su seviyesinin 8,22 metreye ulaşacağını ve kara alanının yüzde 6,5'inin sular altında kalacağını öngörüyor.

evidence.quote: Estimates for the same scenario, but for the year 2500, project that the combined water level would reach 8.22 meters and that 6.5 percent of the land area would be submerged.

claims.claim: Video oyununda savunmasız olarak belirlenen alanlar, gerçek şehirde su baskınına en yatkın üç konum olan Venice Beach, Pacific Palisades ve Los Angeles Limanı ile örtüştü.

evidence.quote: The comparison revealed that the areas identified as vulnerable in the video game coincided with the three locations in the real city most likely to experience flooding: Venice Beach, Pacific Palisades, and the Port of Los Angeles.
